body:
Fixes #25

Automatic spacing now discovers gaps for `2222` without manual setup and measures the painted shafts and markers, including stroke width and configurable clearance. Sharp arrows keep acute tips and balance their painted endpoints by default; rounded, bevelled and inherited corners and legacy lengths remain selectable. Each link now has a responsive card containing all nine existing inputs, with visible gap overrides.

The shared geometry serves the preview, solver, SVG and raster exports. Gallery/rain defaults and existing link actions are preserved. Optional solver diagnostics default off. The bounded search remains heuristic: unattainable clearance within the configured bounds retains its residual score.

### Reproduction and verification

- Original failure: open `/network/?code=2222&rotation=90&solve=true&lang=en`. The original drawing collapses near the referenced middle. Automatic mode now finds both reference gaps and reduces the fixture's painted score from about 7.4386 to 0.
- Reference arrangement: `/network/?code=2222&rotation=90&turns=15+-15&gaps=0.18+0.18+%7E+%7E&lang=en`. Equal gaps now produce balanced painted extents. The same fixture at `endAngle=5` keeps its sharp tip.
- `node experiments/issue-25-reproduce.mjs` runs the new tests against the original source and restores current files: all six issue regressions fail as expected. A seventh regression protects the zero-gap fallback discovered during implementation.
- 717 unit tests; ESLint, formatting, file limits, secret scan, dependency audit, production build and all 120 CV PDFs.
- Native Chromium, Firefox and WebKit checks cover sharp endpoints at 5°/15°/45°, exact Apply/share/reload SVG equality, card editing/removal and English/Russian mobile layout. The raster check supersamples acute tips while retaining the same normalized tolerance.
- Existing editor/download, issue 19, issue 21 and issue 23 suites remain in the three-engine CI matrix, including the full 4131-card gallery and actual compositor checks. Local compatibility checks run sequentially within the container budget.

[Detailed case study, requirement map, chronology, research and alternatives](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-25-665823cdf9ad/docs/case-studies/issue-25/README.md), [validation and archived logs/data](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-25-665823cdf9ad/docs/case-studies/issue-25/VALIDATION.md).

Final CI [40404466882](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/actions/runs/40404466882) passed for `09160c7099d84858dbc19a301451b9d2d4337c1c` (created 2026-10-26 21:27:10 UTC): all checks, 717 tests, five browser suites in each of Chromium/Firefox/macOS WebKit, the production build and all 120 CV PDFs. The complete logs and browser evidence from source run [40401691502](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/actions/runs/40401691502) are archived in the case study. Final review confirmed that `main` is an ancestor, there are no outstanding issue/PR comments, and the working tree is clean.
